title: Disney Selling $8 Million Super Bowl Ad Spots Despite Advertiser Pushback

facts.fact: Disney has sold some Super Bowl LXI commercial spots for about $8 million each amid pushback from advertisers, according to the page.
facts.quote: Disney has sold some Super Bowl LXI commercial spots for about $8 million amid pushback from advertisers.

facts.fact: According to people familiar with negotiations (as reported by Variety), Disney has sold a "significant chunk" of 30-second Super Bowl spots for about $8 million each.
facts.quote: the company has now sold a “significant chunk” of 30-second spots for about $8 million each.

facts.fact: Disney's first Super Bowl under its NFL deal with ESPN is scheduled to air on February 14, 2027.
facts.quote: their first Super Bowl since 2026 will air on February 14, 2027

facts.fact: A source told Variety that Disney has already sold 50% of its game-time inventory.
facts.quote: a source told Variety that Disney has sold 50% of their game-time inventory already.

facts.fact: Disney stated that it has seen strong early demand driving double-digit units sold at $9 million each.
facts.quote: driving double-digit units at $9 million each in addition to spending across Disney’s football portfolio

facts.fact: Disney stated that investment is coming from seven major advertising categories, led by A.I., finance, and pharma.
facts.quote: investment coming from seven major categories, led by A.I., finance, and pharma.

facts.fact: According to media buyers, the advertisers who bought $9 million units were largely "independents" new to the Super Bowl without long-term relationships with Disney.
facts.quote: the advertisers who bought $9 million units were largely “independents” new to the Super Bowl who don’t have long-term relationships with Disney.

facts.fact: Returning Super Bowl advertisers usually get first pick of the next year's spots, a perk Disney reportedly did not want to offer.
facts.quote: Returning Super Bowl advertisers usually enjoy first pick of the next year’s spots.
